edge.title: Muon → Distributed Shampoo (−1/4 roots, Adam grafting), 4150 steps
edge.summary: The hidden matrices switch from Muon to the imported DistributedShampoo: a bias-corrected gradient EMA (β1=0.9, no Nesterov) is preconditioned as L^-1/4·M·R^-1/4, where L and R are β2=0.95 EMAs of GGᵀ and GᵀG whose inverse roots are recomputed by eigendecomposition every 5 steps. Each matrix's Shampoo direction is rescaled to the norm of an Adam step (grafting) and decoupled wd=0.2 is applied at lr=0.0015; aux AdamW, schedule and init are as in #12. Reaching 3.28 takes 4100 steps (of 4150 scheduled) vs 3325 for Muon.

changes.label: Hidden optimizer Muon → Shampoo
changes.detail: optimizer2 = DistributedShampoo(block 2-D params, lr=0.0015, betas=(0.9, 0.95), max_preconditioner_dim=8192, precondition_frequency=5) with the default RootInvShampooPreconditionerConfig: unblocked fp32 factors (3072 < 8192), library-default exponent 1/(2·order) = −1/4 per side, eigh with ε=1e-12 added first.

changes.label: Adam grafting
changes.detail: grafting_config=AdamPreconditionerConfig(beta2=0.95, epsilon=1e-10): each matrix's Shampoo direction is rescaled to the Frobenius norm of the Adam direction m̂/(√v̂+1e-10). start_preconditioning_step=-1 resolves to 5, so steps 1–4 use the pure Adam direction.

changes.label: Decoupled wd 0.2 at lr 0.0015
changes.detail: weight_decay=0.2 with WeightDecayType.DECOUPLED: 0.2·W is added to the search direction before it is multiplied by lr, i.e. 3e-4 shrink per step at peak.

changes.label: Steps 3350/3325 → 4150/4100
changes.detail: train_steps=4150; result read at 4100 (50-step early stop, lr ≈ 1.7% of peak).

changes.label: Muon code removed; library import
changes.detail: Muon/Newton–Schulz code deleted; imports distributed_shampoo and builds DDPDistributedConfig(communication_dtype=float32, num_trainers_per_group=world_size, communicate_params=True), or SingleDeviceDistributedConfig on 1 GPU.

edge.parent_check: Inferred; consistent. The skeleton (multi-trial loop, tail validation, explicit init, aux AdamW, 0.7 cooldown) is identical to #12; only the hidden optimizer and step counts change.
edge.noise: Deletion of the Muon/Newton–Schulz code and the distributed-config helper.

mechanisms.name: Shampoo (Distributed Shampoo, Adam-grafted)
mechanisms.explain: Each hidden matrix keeps Kronecker factors L ← β2·L + (1−β2)·GGᵀ and R ← β2·R + (1−β2)·GᵀG of the raw gradient; every precondition_frequency steps their inverse 4th roots are recomputed by eigendecomposition. The step direction is L^-1/4·m̂·R^-1/4 for the bias-corrected gradient EMA m̂, rescaled per matrix to the norm of an Adam step (grafting), plus decoupled weight decay. With zero betas and per-step roots the direction reduces to the polar factor UVᵀ, the spectral-descent direction of #22 (grafting still sets its norm).

caveats: The script imports the third-party distributed_shampoo package instead of inlining it (rule 4 asks for inlined optimizer code); a copy (~28k lines incl. tests) is vendored next to the log in results/20260513_shampoo_1_4_power/, so exact behavior depends on that library version. n=4, mean 3.2776 at 4100.
